papers.title: Synergistic effects of graphite and molybdenum disulfide solid lubricants embedded in femtosecond laser-textured polycrystalline cubic boron nitride tools on cutting performance of Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: To address the inherent challenges in machining Ti-6Al-4V—namely severe tool wear, poor surface roughness, and unfavorable chip morphology (e.g. chip curling)—this paper proposes an experimental approach utilizing micro-dimple textures filled with a hybrid of graphite and molybdenum disulfide (MoS 2 ) solid lubricants. The micro-dimple textures were fabricated on the rake face of polycrystalline cubic boron nitride tools via femtosecond laser texturing, followed by embedding graphite, MoS 2 , and their hybrid mixtures into the textures to develop self-lubricating tools. Dry cutting experiments were conducted to comprehensively evaluate the machining performance based on rake face wear morphology, surface roughness, microhardness, chip morphology, and chip serration degree. The results demonstrate that, compared to the conventional tool (T0), the hybrid-lubricated tool (T4) significantly mitigates tool wear. Specifically, Ti-element adhesion was reduced by approximately 18%, while surface roughness, microhardness, and the chip serration degree were decreased by about 26%, 18%, and 19%, respectively.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究的是切削刀具的纹理与润滑剂，并非Ti-6Al-4V的后处理工艺。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not study any post-processing treatment applied to Ti-6Al-4V; it focuses on tool surface texturing and lubrication for machining Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 为解决钛合金加工难题，提出在刀具表面制造微坑并填充固体润滑剂。
summary_zh.method: 在PCBN刀具表面用飞秒激光加工微坑，填充石墨和MoS2混合物。
summary_zh.result: 混合润滑刀具显著减少了刀具磨损和表面粗糙度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过干切削实验验证刀具性能。

summary_en.motivation: The motivation is to address tool wear and poor surface quality in Ti-6Al-4V machining.
summary_en.method: The method uses femtosecond laser to create micro-dimple textures on PCBN tools and fills them with graphite/MoS2 solid lubricants.
summary_en.result: The results show significant reduction in tool wear and surface roughness.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via dry cutting experiments and characterization.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要关注TiB/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料的固溶时效处理，属于后处理工艺，与L1层关注的Ti-6Al-4V基体力学/疲劳性能直接相关性较弱。
llm.why_not_core: The paper focuses on post-processing heat treatment of a TiB-reinforced Ti-6Al-4V composite, not on the as-built or process-state mechanical/fatigue characterization of the Ti-6Al-4V alloy itself, and is thus outside the core scope of L1.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过热处理调控LPBF TiB/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料的微观组织以提升力学性能
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF制备的TiB/Ti-6Al-4V复合材料进行固溶和时效处理
summary_zh.result: 热处理后复合材料的强度和塑性得到改善
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试（拉伸等）验证性能提升

summary_en.motivation: To regulate the microstructure of LPBF-fabricated TiB/Ti-6Al-4V composites via heat treatment for enhanced mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Solution and ageing treatments were applied to LPBF TiB/Ti-6Al-4V composites, and the resulting microstructure and mechanical properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: The heat treatment improved both strength and ductility of the composite compared to the as-built state.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (e.g., tensile tests) was used to validate the property enhancement.
